summary: Single coherent slice: add pow (a ** b) to POST /calculate end-to-end — OpenAPI op enum, Calculator.ocl contract (no precondition), a new Gherkin Scenario, src/calculator.ts implementation, and contract tests — as one additive follow-on change with no independently-failing sub-behavior.
acceptance_of_whole:
Scenario: Calculator service supports pow via POST /calculate
  Given the arithmetic calculator service for clients
  When a client requests op: "pow" with two operands a and b
  Then the result equals the mathematical power of those operands (a ** b) for representative inputs
  And the operation never fails with a precondition error
  And existing add/sub/mul/div/mod and memory operations continue to behave unchanged

human_gate.reason: Scope, precondition exclusion, and stack are already settled by the ChangeBrief (gate required: false, confidence: high); this WorkPlan only slices that Brief into one checkable item and introduces no new judgment, breaking change, or money/authz boundary.

items.intent: Add the pow operation (a ** b) to the existing calculator service end-to-end: extend the OpenAPI op enum additively, extend Calculator.ocl with a pow contract that has no precondition, add a Gherkin Scenario for pow, implement Calculator.pow and the calculate() switch arm in src/calculator.ts, and extend the contract tests to assert pow results and the absence of a PreconditionError — without touching memory operations or existing add/sub/mul/div/mod behavior.
items.acceptance_criterion:
Scenario: Power raises the base to the exponent
  Given a calculator service available to clients
  When the client raises one number to the power of another
  Then the result equals the mathematical power of those operands
  And the operation is never rejected by a precondition check
items.scenario_name: Power raises the base to the exponent

human_gate.reason: Same rationale as WorkPlan-level gate: settled scope, additive-only change, no precondition/breaking/money/authz boundary introduced.
